facts.fact: Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen said on 28 August 2026 that digital occurrence books would be introduced, linked to police communication centres, so that the public can report crime remotely; he spoke of them as still to come and gave no station in which one was in use.
The Interior Cabinet Secretary announced the digital occurrence book on 28 August 2026 as one of his ministry's reforms to digitise the operations of the National Police Service.

On 28 August 2026 the Interior Cabinet Secretary announced that digital occurrence books would accompany police communication centres to be set up first in Nairobi, Mombasa, Nyeri, Nakuru, Eldoret and Kisumu; it is an announcement of intent, with no date given for the occurrence book itself.
